_note: THE CONTENT UNIT IS AN INCIDENT PACKAGE, NOT AN ANOMALY (GDD 15.1). An anomaly file holds rules and nothing about where; a map file holds geometry and nothing about what happened. This binds the two, and it is the only reason two different incidents can share one floor — which is exactly what the vertical slice asks for (26.2). It carries the things that belong to neither on their own: where the thing starts, what is lying about to be found, and the briefing the squad is read.

briefing.headline: Missing maintenance crew, sub-level 2
briefing.report: A maintenance crew sealed the floor after reporting 'cold that moves'. Two of the three came back. Mains have been down six days.

_placementNote:
⚠ AN EVIDENCE SOURCE CAN SHADOW A BREAKER, AND THAT BREAKS THE MISSION RATHER THAN THE PICKUP.

Two halves to it. `contextAction` is nearest-wins, and `sourceInReach` returns the FIRST hit in this array rather than the nearest one, over a probe of `reachMetres + 0.6` = 2.8m. So (a) two sources inside 2.8m of each other means the earlier one answers for both, and once it is logged the later one has no verb at all — the candidate is only pushed when the ledger does not already hold it. And (b) a source within 2.8m of where an operative stands to work a breaker or a door WINS, because it is nearer, and the breaker simply does not appear.

(b) is the one that costs a whole operation, and it happened here during this very edit: `spent-cells` was first authored at [-3.4, -7.8], 2.7m from the office breaker at [-6.0, -7.0]. The containment bot stopped at (-4.51, -7.11) to throw it and was offered 'Check the packs' instead. No office circuit, no office door, no office, and every assertion after it fell over. This is the third time this class of bug has been found in this project.

So the standard is an INVARIANT, not a feeling: every source added or moved here is more than `reach + probe` = 5.0m from every door centre and every circuit switch. Beyond 5.0m a source cannot even be a candidate at any point from which the fixture is in reach, so it cannot win there — no ordering, no luck. The measured minimum is 6.23m (`spent-cells` to the office breaker).

Two sources authored before this note sit inside that and are pinned where they are by tools/m0-tests.js, which walks to their literal coordinates: `maintenance-log` is 1.84m from the storage breaker (the office is 3.8m square and holds the desk, the breaker and a door — it cannot be fixed by moving the log), and `survivor-account` is 1.56m from the cargo cache. Both survive on ordering: m0 reads the log before it throws the breaker, and the cache is taken from by distance rather than by verb. Neither is a pattern to copy.

The five sources added at revision 0.2.0 are SPREAD, deliberately. Evidence that all lives in one room is one pickup wearing five hats. The muster board and the charging rack are safe reading in the bay; the chart recorder, the crew's imager and the two lamps are up the west run and Aisle A, where the draught is, and cost the walk.
